strategyPoints: Tire wear is a major concern on this abrasive surface, even on this short 0.9km layout. Managing the tires will be crucial for a strong finish.
The Joker Lap strategy will be key here. When to take it, and how to minimize the time loss, will be the deciding factor for many drivers.
With such a short lap, traffic management is critical. Getting stuck behind a slower car can ruin your race on the Tykki Short Circuit.
The pit window is relatively short here, so teams need to be lightning-fast with their tire changes to avoid losing valuable time.
Fuel load is less of a concern on this short track, allowing teams to focus on other performance parameters.
The start is absolutely crucial on this short layout. A good start can put you in a commanding position from the get-go.
The compact nature of the Short Circuit means that any small mistake can be costly, so consistency is key.
Suspension setup is critical here. Finding the right balance between grip and stability will be essential for a competitive lap time.
